name: Gawain
source:
A knight with fiery red hair and eyes, and a fiery spirit to match. He wields a greataxe, and while he can be blunt and ill-mannered, at least you always know exactly where you stand with him. He opens up to the heroine relatively quickly. He lost his two younger sisters in battle once, which led to him growing fixated with achieving the title of "Strongest." This has given him a bit of an inferiority complex with regards to Lancelot.

"I'll have to beat everything, if I want to keep anyone from laying a finger on you."

[From in-game profile]
